summary: Backend and frontend testing of Directory maintenance: safe delete of apps and companies, purge of empty companies, rebuild of legacy certificates, bulk ZIP upload of certificates, and permissions. Backend: 15 of 16 pytest tests pass and 1 is skipped. The purge test was skipped on purpose, because the only empty company is a real one: emp_010e8d59c8d6 'Software A2 de A2Softway'. GET /references returns quotes (5), projects (8) and certificates for int_84c3acb5fc3b. DELETE /safe returns 403 for qa.editor, 409 with detail.message, quotes and projects when the app is referenced, 200 for a new 'QA Duplicado' app, and then 404. Company /safe returns 400 when the company has apps, 200 when it is empty, then 404, and 403 for the editor. Rebuild-legacy is idempotent: created=0 and skipped=3 (3MIT, Bigwise, Tealca) with a clear message. All 33 legacy certificates have status vigente and created_at equal to certified_at, and the download is a valid %PDF. Bulk-upload: a unique match is stored with origin manual and label 'Carga en lote - <user>'; non-PDF files are ignored; a fake .pdf gets 'No es un PDF válido'; no match gets 'Sin coincidencia'; twins get 'Ambiguo entre 2 aplicativos'; an invalid ZIP returns 400. Frontend: all flows pass for admin, gerente and editor (see context).

minor.issue: The example file from the brief, 'Certificado_Binaural C.A_Odoo Versión 16.pdf', returns 'Ambiguo entre 2 aplicativos'. The reason is that Binaural C.A / 'Odoo Versión  16' exists twice as exact duplicates (int_f6cbdce034f9 and int_66e555d93dd7, same empresa, both Certificado). There are 16 name+app_name duplicate groups in the DB. When the candidates are exact twins, consider a tie-break: prefer the twin with quotes/projects or certified_at, or attach to one twin. The user said duplicates exist, so their real ZIPs will often hit this.

A certificate is inserted without status (it shows as vigente by default) and earlier vigente certificates are not marked 'reemplazado'. An app can end up with 2 vigente certificates (for example a legacy rebuilt one plus the uploaded original). There is also no dedupe, so uploading the same ZIP twice duplicates the rows. There is no ZIP size or entry limit.

Information only: 312 apps have status 'Certificado' but no certificate. 309 of them have no certified_at/cert_component, so they cannot be rebuilt; only a ZIP upload or a manual upload will cover them.

ui_bugs.issue: The link goes to /quotes?search=COT-..., but Quotes.jsx only reads ?highlight= (line 397). The link opens the full quotes list unfiltered. Fix: use `/quotes?highlight=${encodeURIComponent(q.quote_number)}`.

issues: If GET /references fails, the dialog falls back to empty references and enables Eliminar. The backend still guards with 409, but it would be better to show an error state.

action_items: DeleteAppDialog.jsx: change the quote link from ?search= to ?highlight= so Quotes.jsx highlights the quote
bulk-upload: add a tie-break for exact duplicate apps (same name and app_name), otherwise the Binaural-style files stay unmatched
bulk-upload: mark earlier vigente certificates as 'reemplazado' (as reissue does) and/or skip duplicates by filename+size; add a size limit
critical_code_review_comments: purge-empty: `distinct('empresa_integradora_id')` followed by a separate find has a small race window if an app is created at the same moment. Acceptable.
rebuild-legacy uses distinct over all certificates, including anulado ones, so an app whose only certificate was annulled is never rebuilt. Probably intended.
Rebuilt certificates record created_by_name as the user who ran the rebuild (shows 'QA Integradores' under the origin). Consider 'Sistema'.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; 1 wrong quote link param)

seed_data_creation: Everything was created and then removed by id: the API app 'QA Duplicado xxxx' plus its auto-created empresa; QA companies emp_qa390*; QA apps int_qa390*; and the 'Carga en lote' certificates for the QA apps only. The final check found no QA leftovers, 0 'Carga en lote' certificates, 33 legacy certificates still vigente, and emp_010e8d59c8d6 as the only empty company (real, untouched). Purge was NOT run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use http://localhost:8001 for Python requests. Companies live in collection empresas_integradoras (field razon_social). Fixture: python /app/backend/tests/ui_fixture_iter390_maint.py create|cleanup. POST /api/integrators auto-creates an empresa that becomes empty after the app is deleted, so clean it up. Do not run purge while emp_010e8d59c8d6 (real) is the empty company. UI results: the admin sees the 3 maintenance buttons; purge shows the count (2 with the QA empty company, 1 after it was deleted via company-delete-btn + confirm); rebuild opens the result dialog with 0 created and 3 pending; the ZIP upload shows 1 associated and 1 'Sin coincidencia'. For int_84c3acb5fc3b the dialog shows blocked, 5 quotes and 8 projects, with confirm disabled. The QA app with a certificate is blocked by delete-app-certs; after the certificate was removed it shows delete-app-ok and deletes, and the company then shows 0 Apps with its delete button. The Ficha Certificados tab shows 'Reconstruido - certificación del 2026-09-23' (Vigente) plus manual-cert-btn for gerente. The editor sees no maintenance, delete or manual-cert buttons.
